name: stub_single_move_instruction
description: Recovered as a one-instruction stub that is only referenced by an absolute move. The decompiled body shown is a copy of the following routine and does not match the single instruction, so no separate behaviour can be attributed to it.

name: configure_disk_dma_then_delay
description: Writes a sequence of custom-chip disk and DMA control values, stores a word to a memory cell, writes two control-port bytes, then runs a fixed countdown delay before returning.

name: step_counter_until_target
description: Runs a loop that increments a counter until it equals a second register value, calling a helper on each pass, then writes two control-port bytes and ends with a fixed countdown delay.

name: scan_words_for_value_eleven
description: Walks a range of words, advancing a counter until it reaches the end value, and calls a helper with the incremented counter whenever the loaded word equals 11, then returns the last loaded value.

name: call_three_helpers_pass_through
description: Calls three helper routines in sequence and returns the two incoming data registers unchanged as one pair.

name: copy_block_into_buffer
description: Optionally calls helpers to select a source, then copies 128 longwords (512 bytes) from a computed offset in the loaded data into the buffer at the address passed in.

name: write_block_from_buffer
description: Copies 128 longwords (512 bytes) from the buffer at the incoming address to a computed offset in the loaded data, the reverse direction of the block read routine.

name: wait_status_then_clear_flag
description: Sets a flag bit in a control byte, polls a status byte with a delay between checks while one bit stays set, clears a stored word, then clears the flag bit again.

name: poll_status_bit_with_timeout
description: Writes a control value, runs a countdown delay, then polls a status bit in nested countdown loops, returning early as soon as the bit is clear and storing the final counter otherwise.

name: release_control_port_with_delay
description: Writes two values to a control byte, runs a fixed countdown delay, and makes one helper call before returning.

name: step_by_difference_with_delay
description: Compares the incoming word with the previously stored value, sets direction and parity bits in a control byte, then issues one helper call and a fixed delay per unit of difference before storing the new value.

name: toggle_strobe_on_even_count
description: Increments a stored counter; on even values it pulses a control bit with a fixed delay and waits until a status bit clears, and on odd values it sets a different control bit instead.

name: pulse_control_bit_and_wait
description: Sets, clears and sets bit 0 of a control byte, waits a fixed countdown, then polls a status bit until it clears.

name: start_read_with_retries
description: Resets stored state, programs custom-chip disk registers to start a read, polls a status bit with a bounded iteration count, and retries up to four times, storing failure codes in the result when the bit never sets or the value does not match.

name: decode_mfm_sector_from_disk
description: Waits on the disk byte-ready register, skips a run of alternating-bit sync words, then decodes raw disk words by combining their odd and even bit halves into a destination buffer.

name: fill_buffer_with_gap_pattern
description: Fills a 7168-word buffer with the alternating-bit pattern used as a track gap.

name: start_disk_dma_if_ready
description: Checks a status bit and returns an error code if it is clear; otherwise it programs the disk DMA registers with the buffer address, triggers the transfer, calls a wait helper, and restores the DMA control register.

name: start_disk_dma_transfer
description: Programs the disk DMA start registers with the buffer address, triggers the transfer, calls a wait helper, and restores the DMA control register.

name: fill_block_with_marker_longs
description: Fills a block of 1536 longwords with one repeated four-byte marker value.

name: write_sync_header_and_gap
description: Writes a gap of alternating-bit words, then four sync words and one more gap word, and then emits 3072 data words through a helper before writing a trailing gap.

name: encode_mfm_word_to_buffer
description: Computes the MFM clock bits for a 16-bit data word from its own bit pattern and the preceding bit, stores the encoded word at the target address, and makes one helper call first.

name: store_mfm_encoded_word
description: Computes the MFM clock bits for a 16-bit data word from its bit pattern and the preceding bit, then stores the encoded word at the target address without any other work.

name: start_disk_read_if_ready
description: Returns an error code if a status bit is clear; otherwise it programs the disk DMA registers with the buffer address, calls a wait helper, and restores the DMA control register.

name: start_disk_dma_with_wait
description: Clears a stored result, programs the disk DMA registers with the buffer address and a different transfer mode than the other start routines, calls a wait helper, and restores the DMA control register.

name: wait_status_edge_then_set
description: Waits for a status bit to clear and then to set again, and writes the value 2 to a custom-chip register before returning.

name: wait_disk_block_interrupt_flag
description: Polls the disk-block bit of the interrupt request register until it is set, then acknowledges it by writing to the interrupt request register.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Contains only a return instruction and is called from six places. The hardware accesses listed for it do not appear in the decompiled body, so it performs no work of its own.

name: compare_stored_values_loop
description: Stores an incoming value, then loops calling helpers until a stored status value is negative or equals a second stored value, and finishes with the control-port writes and fixed delay.

name: release_control_port_and_wait
description: Writes two values to a control byte, runs a fixed countdown delay, and makes one helper call before returning.

name: setup_disk_sync_and_wait
description: Sets two global variables, programs the disk DMA and sync registers with the standard MFM sync word, makes a conditional helper call, writes control-port bytes, and finishes with a fixed countdown delay.

name: decompress_lz_byte_stream
description: Decodes a byte-oriented compressed stream: literal runs are copied out, and back-reference codes copy previously written bytes over a distance and length taken from the control byte, stopping on a zero control byte or when the output count runs out.

name: apply_masks_to_word_grid
description: Derives a mask index from each source byte and a running value, then ANDs groups of words in a grid of rows and columns with mask words from a lookup table, over a fixed number of outer and inner passes.

name: lookup_table_entry_word
description: Reads a 16-bit index from memory, scales it by four, and returns the word stored at that position in a fixed lookup table.

name: advance_bouncing_oscillator_entries
description: Loops over a list of entries, advancing each stored value by a per-entry step and wrapping it within a 360-unit range; a global step reverses direction when a counter reaches its positive or negative limit, updating table entries as it goes.

name: setup_blitter_registers
description: Sets the blitter mask, modulo and pointer registers, waits while the blitter is busy, and writes the blitter size register to start a blit.

name: setup_and_start_blit
description: Sets blitter masks and modulo registers, waits while the blitter is busy, writes the pointer and size registers to start a blit, and then calls a helper.

name: dispatch_jump_table_entry
description: Compares an input index with a stored limit and returns if it is not above it; otherwise it calls the routine selected from a jump table by that index.

name: setup_interrupt_table_entry
description: Uses a one-based index to select a 24-byte record of pointers and values and writes them into the referenced memory; when a flag is set it saves an interrupt vector, stores a status word, and enables the vertical-blank interrupt through the interrupt-enable register.

name: call_two_helpers
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns, with no other work.

name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Calls one helper routine and returns, with no other work.

name: store_word_to_global
description: Stores the incoming 16-bit value into a fixed absolute memory word and returns.

name: set_global_byte_max
description: Writes the value 255 to one global byte and returns.

name: copy_indexed_table_word
description: Uses the incoming index, scaled by four, to copy one word from a fixed table into a field of a record reached through a second table.

name: return_without_work
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no observable work.

name: poll_vertical_blank_interrupt_state
description: Reads the interrupt enable register and checks the master-enable and vertical-blank bits; when both are set and a flag is nonzero it calls a helper, otherwise it stores the masked enable bits in a global.

name: mask_and_store_word
description: Masks the incoming word with a fixed bit mask and writes the result to a custom-chip register at a fixed offset from the base pointer.

name: handle_cia_interrupt_flag
description: Copies a status byte through a stored pointer; when its low bit is set it calls one helper if the byte is nonzero, then sets the byte to 8 and returns. The other path has no valid return in the decompiled output.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Made of bytes that do not decode as instructions; the decompiler shows only a halt, so no behaviour is recovered for it.

name: init_tracker_module_playback
description: Checks the module header for the four-character format tag, selects the sample table layout, computes the highest pattern number, clears the four audio channel volume registers and the DMA control register, and initialises the per-channel playback state.

name: build_sample_channel_table
description: Walks the thirty-byte sample records of a tracker module and, for each one, computes a start address and length from its stored length, repeat start and repeat length, writing the results into a channel table.

name: audio_tick_routine_stub
description: Recorded as a one-instruction entry, but the decompiled body shown is the audio tick routine; the listing is inconsistent with the instruction count, so only the body is described here.

name: advance_tick_and_set_dma
description: Advances a tick counter and, at the speed value, moves the playback row; for each of four channels it writes the audio pointer and length registers from the channel state when active, enables DMA, and then copies sample bytes. The body is the same as the preceding audio tick routine.

name: check_flag_and_increment
description: Adds 16 to a stored counter; when a flag byte is zero it also calls four helper routines in sequence.

name: process_tracker_cell_effects
description: Decodes one pattern cell for a channel: it looks up a note period from a table, applies the effect code (such as a sample offset or a fine-tune setting), and updates the channel period, sample pointer and length in both the audio registers and the channel table.

name: scale_volume_with_effect_dispatch
description: Copies a stored value into a second field, optionally calls a routine chosen from a jump table by a byte in the record, then scales the record volume by a master volume value divided by a fixed constant.

name: stub_undecodable_bytes
description: Stub decoded from bytes that are not valid instructions; only a halt is shown, so no behaviour is recovered.

name: select_modulated_table_value
description: Chooses a value using a counter taken modulo three: for two of the three cases it searches a 36-entry table for the first entry above the current value and stores its paired entry, and in the remaining case it stores a default field.

name: select_table_value_variant
description: Variant of the neighbouring table-value routine that builds its lookup index from the incoming data register without setting bit 0, using the same modulo-three selection and 36-entry search.

name: subtract_and_clamp_minimum
description: Subtracts the incoming value from a stored field, clamps the result to a minimum of 113, and copies it to a second field.

name: add_and_clamp_maximum
description: Adds the incoming value to a stored field, clamps the result to a maximum of 856, and copies it to a second field.

name: slide_period_and_lookup
description: Applies a slide step taken from a parameter byte to a stored period, stopping at a limit; when the effect nibble is set it also looks up the nearest entry in a 36-entry period table for the stored value.

name: apply_period_slide_step
description: Applies the stored slide step to a period value, stopping at a limit, and when the effect nibble is set looks up the nearest table entry. It is the same slide logic as the preceding routine without the parameter update.

name: compute_vibrato_offset
description: Updates the depth and speed nibbles from the parameter byte when it is nonzero, selects a waveform value from a 32-entry sine table, a ramp or a constant, scales it by depth, and writes the base value plus this offset while advancing the phase.

name: compute_waveform_offset
description: Computes the same waveform offset from the phase and waveform fields as the preceding routine and writes the base value plus offset, advancing the phase; it does not read a parameter byte.

name: chain_two_helper_calls
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns.

name: run_two_helpers_return
description: Calls two helper routines and returns; the body is identical to the preceding entry.

name: compute_clamped_volume_offset
description: Updates the depth nibble from the parameter byte, derives a waveform value as in the neighbouring oscillator routines, scales it, adds it to a base volume, clamps the result between zero and 64, and stores it as the output volume while advancing the phase.

name: scale_and_clamp_volume_output
description: Scales an input byte by a stored depth nibble, negates it when the sign flag is set, adds a base volume, clamps the result between zero and 64, stores it as the output volume and advances the phase.

name: scale_volume_by_depth
description: Scales an input byte by a stored depth nibble, applies the sign flag, adds a base volume clamped between zero and 64, stores the result as the output volume and advances the phase.

name: scale_volume_from_table_entry
description: Reads a byte from a table at an index passed in, scales it by a stored depth nibble, applies the sign flag, adds a base volume, clamps the result between zero and 64, and stores it as the output volume.

name: clamp_volume_difference
description: Subtracts the second input from the first, clamps the difference between zero and 64, stores it as the output volume and advances the phase.

name: apply_volume_slide
description: Applies a volume slide from a parameter byte: the high nibble adds to the stored volume with an upper limit of 64, while the low nibble subtracts with a lower limit of zero, and the result is stored as the output volume.

name: init_channel_record_fields
description: Stores the incoming value minus one into one field of a record, clears a second field and sets a third field to the maximum byte value.

name: set_volume_clamped_to_max
description: Clamps the incoming value to a maximum of 64 and stores it in two fields of the record.

name: decode_packed_byte_value
description: Clears one field and sets another to the maximum byte value, decodes the incoming byte with its high nibble counting tens and its low nibble counting ones, and stores the value only when it is below 64.

name: update_counter_and_flag
description: When the high nibble of a control byte is set, adds a table value selected by that nibble to a signed byte; if the sum has its top bit set it clears the byte, advances a counter that wraps at a bound, and negates the control byte.

name: store_masked_byte
description: Masks the incoming byte with a five-bit mask and, when the result is nonzero, stores it in one byte of a record and clears the byte next to it.

name: store_helper_result_global
description: Calls one helper routine and stores the 32-bit value it returns into a fixed global longword.

name: arm_countdown_and_call
description: Sets a countdown counter to 64 and a flag to 1, calls two helpers, invokes the routine at a fixed address, and then calls one further helper.

name: countdown_then_clear_flag
description: Counts a stored counter down to zero, running a fixed delay loop on each pass, then clears the counter and a flag and calls four helpers.

name: clear_counter_and_flag
description: Clears a stored counter and a flag byte, then calls four helpers in sequence.

name: call_four_helpers
description: Calls four helper routines in sequence and returns.

name: run_four_helpers_return
description: Calls four helper routines in sequence and returns; the body is identical to the preceding entry.

name: dispatch_on_index_nine
description: Returns when a stored index is below nine; otherwise it calls the routine selected from a jump table by a stored word offset.

name: set_counter_and_dispatch
description: Stores the incoming word in a counter, returns when a stored index is below five, and otherwise calls the routine selected from a jump table.

name: build_four_word_entry_table
description: Fills a table of four-word entries: each entry takes a stored start value, a fixed marker word, a second stored value and the return value of a helper call, with a carry test ending the loop, then writes a closing group of four fixed words.

name: repeat_entry_table_build
description: Builds the same four-word entry table as the preceding routine, using the same loop and closing group of words.

name: step_value_toward_target
description: Moves the current value one unit at a time toward a stored target, adjusting the low nibble, high nibble and high byte in turn, and returns the stepped value. A negative target sets a flag and returns a fallback word, and while that flag is set a counter is advanced.

name: increment_counters_and_callback
description: Increments a global counter and a second counter, and when a flag byte is nonzero calls the routine whose address is stored in a pointer.

name: update_state_byte_mode
description: Computes a bit mask from a register and a shift count, then updates a state byte from its previous value: the 64 state sets 64, the 32 state sets 32, and the 16 state calls a helper and sets 16.

name: clear_bit_and_update_state
description: Clears one bit of an incoming value and updates a state byte with the same state rules as the preceding routine, without a mask update.

name: advance_state_byte_machine
description: Updates a state byte from its previous value: the 64 state sets 64, the 32 state sets 32, and the 16 state calls a helper and sets 16. The interrupt register accesses listed for it do not appear in the decompiled body.

name: decode_joystick_direction_bits
description: Builds a direction value from bits of a stored input word, including a pair of bits derived by an exclusive-or of the word with its shifted copy, sets the top bit when one state bit is clear, and stores the result in a global byte.

name: save_state_and_set_eight
description: When bit 3 of a state byte is set it copies the byte into a second global, then sets the state byte to 8 and returns the incoming value.

name: run_keyboard_handshake_timer
description: When one state bit is clear and another is set, calls a helper, sets the state, waits until a serial-port bit goes high, runs a countdown delay, and clears the state; in every case it finally sets the state byte to 8. The timer register accesses listed for it are not in the decompiled body.

name: install_copper_list_pointer
description: Writes the copper list pointer register, then writes control values for the CIA-A timer and for the custom interrupt and DMA enable registers, and calls two helpers.

name: call_helpers_if_table_value
description: Reads a value through an index table and calls one helper routine; when that value is nonzero it also calls four further helper routines.

name: update_position_with_bounds_check
description: Adjusts a stored position by a delta within a bounded range, clamping it at the limits, and returns a packed result that carries one of several status codes chosen from fixed table values.

name: initialise_record_fields
description: Stores a fixed set of sentinel values and the incoming parameter registers into fields of a record: several words are set to minus one or minus two, a pair of words is derived from the parameters, and longword values and pointers are stored.

name: initialise_record_fields_alt
description: Same decompiled body as the preceding record initialisation routine.

name: initialise_record_fields_dup
description: Same decompiled body as the preceding record initialisation routine.

name: initialise_record_fields_repeat
description: Same decompiled body as the preceding record initialisation routine.

name: initialise_record_fields_entry
description: Same decompiled body as the preceding record initialisation routine.

name: store_record_pointers_and_word
description: Stores a combined word and several longword values and pointers at fixed offsets of a record, without the sentinel initialisation of the routines before it.

name: build_offset_table_from_records
description: Walks a list of variable-length records, computing each record's size from its count and stride, and writes the running offset into a parallel table until it reaches a record with a zero count.

name: build_mirrored_waveform_table
description: Builds a table of 90 entries from a source table of word pairs by writing each pair along with its negated, swapped and mirrored copies at fixed strides, producing a symmetric waveform table.

name: undecoded_single_instruction
description: Recorded as one instruction, but no decompiled body is available, so the listing supports only the call and caller facts and no behaviour can be stated.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work.

name: clear_memory_and_probe_patterns
description: Clears a block of memory with zero words up to a fixed end address, calls a routine through a library vector, then compares memory words against fixed instruction-encoding patterns to choose a value that is stored in a global, and makes two more vectored calls.

name: call_library_vector_stub
description: Calls one routine through a pointer at a fixed offset from a stored base and then ends in an undecodable tail, so no further behaviour is recovered.

name: adjust_bcd_and_store
description: Makes two helper calls and one vectored call, applies a decimal adjustment with a borrow test, stores a combined word, and decrements a longword in the record; the decompiled tail does not return normally.

name: call_vector_stub_tail
description: Calls one routine through a pointer at a fixed offset from a stored base and ends in an undecodable tail, so no further behaviour is recovered.

name: call_indirect_vector_entry
description: Calls one routine through a pointer at a fixed offset from a stored base and returns the registers unchanged.

name: patch_blitter_moves_to_calls
description: Scans a range of memory and rewrites move instructions that write the blitter size register into subroutine calls to fixed addresses, including a call to the blitter wait routine for one of the patterns.

name: store_longword_and_masked_word
description: Writes the incoming longword to a target address and, when that address is below a fixed bound, writes a word combined from two inputs into the word after it.

name: set_global_longword_constant
description: Stores a fixed 32-bit constant in a global longword and returns.

name: compute_stack_differences_table
description: Initialises a global longword, fills a local six-entry table with differences between successive stack values and a doubling constant, and stores a fixed final longword.

name: call_vector_per_row_stride
description: When a global state byte is 2 or 3, computes a start address from two inputs and calls a routine through a vector once per row, advancing the address and source pointer by fixed strides; otherwise it makes a single vector call.

name: stub_infinite_loop
description: Contains only an infinite loop and no other operation. The listing records a read of the vertical-position register, but that read does not appear in the decompiled body.

name: start_blit_and_wait_flag
description: Writes the incoming value to the blitter size register, then waits while a global flag bit is set.

name: depack_stream_backwards
description: Unpacks a compressed stream read backwards from the end of the buffer: a bit reader supplies flag bits, literal bytes are copied, and back-references are decoded and copied in reverse, returning a check value or a failure value if the output pointer does not reach the expected start.

name: shift_bits_from_packed_stream
description: Shifts a bit buffer right by a count, refilling it from the previous longword of the packed stream with a marker top bit whenever the buffer empties.

name: adjust_bcd_and_store_copy
description: Same decompiled body as the earlier BCD adjust routine: a decimal adjustment with a borrow test, a stored combined word, and a decremented longword, with a tail that does not return normally.

name: copy_indexed_table_rows
description: Walks an index list until a negative terminator and, for each index, copies a fixed group of words from a source table into the destination, repeating one source word for several outputs.

name: call_routine_four_times
description: Calls one routine four times in a loop and returns.

name: step_command_timer_state
description: Counts down a timer field in a record; when it reaches zero it reloads the timer and applies one of ten commands selected by a command field, such as toggling sign bits, swapping or copying fields, or adjusting a counter within bounds.

name: step_command_timer_repeat
description: Applies the same command logic as the preceding timer routine, but without the initial zero check: it decrements the timer and runs the command when the timer reaches zero.

name: apply_timer_command_step
description: Reloads the timer field from its reload value and applies one of ten commands selected by a command field, using the same command set as the timer routines before it.

name: apply_record_command_from_register
description: Applies one of ten commands selected by the incoming command register to the record, using the same command set as the earlier timer routines.

name: apply_record_command_from_two
description: Variant of the command switch that handles commands two to nine; the copy has no case for command one.

name: apply_record_command_from_three
description: Variant of the command switch that handles commands three to nine on the record.

name: apply_command_on_record_fields
description: Command switch for commands four to nine, operating on record fields addressed by byte offset rather than by array index.

name: apply_command_five_to_nine
description: Command switch for commands five to nine on the record, with the same effects as the matching cases of the earlier switches.

name: apply_command_six_to_nine
description: Command switch for commands six to nine on the record, with the same effects as the matching cases of the earlier switches.

name: apply_command_seven_to_nine
description: Command switch for commands seven to nine on the record, with the same effects as the matching cases of the earlier switches.

name: apply_command_eight_or_nine
description: Command switch that handles only commands eight and nine, swapping and sign-toggling two fields.

name: apply_command_nine_only
description: Handles only command nine, which toggles sign bits and swaps two fields; any other command returns without change.

name: advance_two_axis_oscillator
description: Counts down a delay field and, when it expires, reloads it and steps two 4-bit counters that bounce between limits; the counter values are then added to or subtracted from two position words in the target record, depending on a sign flag.

name: copy_tile_to_two_buffers
description: Copies an eight-row block of source bytes into two destination buffers at fixed offsets, writing each row with a stride of 160 bytes and duplicating every source byte into both buffers.

name: copy_rows_to_two_buffers
description: Copies sixteen rows of words from a source block into two destination buffers, writing each row with a stride of 80 bytes.

name: fade_palette_entries_toward_target
description: Steps sixteen stored colour entries, each split into three 4-bit components, one step toward the matching components of an incoming colour table, incrementing each component that differs; it then ends in an endless loop with no return.

name: fade_palette_32_entries
description: Variant of the preceding palette step for thirty-two entries, with the same per-component step and the same endless loop.

name: load_palette_and_fade_down
description: Copies thirty-two words from a source table into the palette buffer, then decrements each 4-bit colour component toward zero, and ends in an endless loop.

name: load_second_palette_fade_down
description: Same routine as the preceding palette loader but copying from a different source table.

name: clear_two_screen_buffers
description: Zeroes two buffers at fixed addresses, each 32000 bytes long, in one pass of 8000 longwords.

name: call_per_table_entry
description: Calls one helper, then calls another helper for each byte of a table until a terminator value of minus one is reached, and finishes with one more helper call.

name: process_byte_script_until_end
description: Walks a byte list up to a terminator; each byte other than a marker value is passed to a helper, and after the terminator it calls a helper and then ends in an endless loop.

name: configure_display_registers
description: Writes the bitplane modulo and control values and a copper list pointer into the display registers, calls helpers while a flag is set, and finishes by writing two further control values.

name: call_two_then_halt_loop
description: Calls two helper routines, then runs an endless loop with no return.

name: depack_stream_reading_bits
description: Variant of the backwards depacker that reads flag bits through a bit reader and fetches literal and back-reference lengths with a separate bit-reading helper; it returns a check value, or a failure value if the output pointer does not reach the expected start.

name: copy_two_tables_then_halt
description: Copies two table blocks into an offset region in rows of twenty words, walks a byte list calling a helper for each value, sets a global flag, and ends in an endless loop.

name: configure_display_with_checks
description: Writes modulo, control and copper pointer values for the display, checks a global flag through up to three helper calls, and then writes the final display values.

name: clear_record_blocks_then_halt
description: Zeroes twelve fixed-size record blocks by writing longwords and words at set offsets, calls a helper before and after, and ends in an endless loop.

name: copy_block_and_run_grid
description: Copies 8000 longwords from the buffer at the global pointer to another buffer, then calls two helpers in a grid of sixteen by eight passes and ends in an endless loop.

name: read_script_byte_dispatch
description: Reads one byte from a script pointer and advances it. A terminator value resets the pointer to a fixed address and stores one; the values ten, eleven and three enter an endless loop; any other value is stored as the current value and returned.

name: stub_endless_loop
description: Contains only an endless loop, reached from a single call site, with no other operation.

name: or_nibble_table_into_plane
description: Uses the low and high nibbles of a source byte to select two table entries of four words each, then ORs four rows of table bytes into the destination with a stride of 160 bytes.

name: or_nibble_table_offset_copy
description: Same nibble-table OR as the preceding routine, writing one byte further into the destination.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work.

name: cycle_bounded_offset_state
description: Toggles a global bit, calls several helpers, and decrements a state counter; when the counter reaches zero it steps a global offset by 192 within a range of 0 to 1536, cycling it through three values.

name: copy_interleaved_word_rows
description: Copies twenty-four groups of four words from a source table into a destination with a stride of 80 bytes, writing each word to a separate row.

name: copy_interleaved_rows_eight
description: Copies fifteen groups of eight words from a source table into rows with a stride of 80 bytes.

name: copy_rows_into_two_targets
description: Copies sixteen groups of six words into two destinations at once, writing each group to both destinations with a stride of 80 bytes; the final words of each group are single bytes.

name: copy_byte_rows_two_buffers
description: Copies twelve bytes from each of sixteen rows of a source into two destination buffers, writing each row with a stride of 160 bytes.

name: walk_words_then_halt
description: Advances a pointer through 8000 words, reading each word and writing it back in place, then ends in an endless loop.

name: shift_and_mask_scroll_rows
description: Copies a sixteen-word palette block, then derives source and destination addresses from a position value; for sixteen rows it combines source words with a bit mask built from a shift value, and a second pass moves words between rows at a wider offset, shifting the image data by the position.

name: verify_sequence_or_halt
description: Writes a sequence of nine values and a palette block, then compares a global value against a fixed chain of values; when every comparison matches it returns, otherwise it calls eight helpers and ends in an endless loop.

name: call_one_or_twelve_helpers
description: Tests a global value: when it is zero it calls one helper and returns; otherwise it calls twelve helpers in sequence.

name: clear_block_rows_at_offset
description: Clears thirty-two rows of eight longwords at an address computed from two position inputs, writing zero into each row.

name: masked_tile_copy_with_shift
description: Copies thirty-two rows of tile data into a work area, then combines each row with a bit-shifted mask derived from the position, using AND and OR operations, and writes the combined words into the destination rows.

name: advance_position_with_velocity
description: Returns early when a stored position equals a fixed reference pair; otherwise it adds a velocity to the position, subtracting a size value when a coordinate passes its limit, and updates the stored position.

name: call_subroutine_four_times
description: Calls one routine four times in succession and returns.

name: compute_offset_from_reference_point
description: Compares two input coordinates with the reference point 84 and 144, records a signed direction for each axis, and stores the larger distance from the reference as the step size.

name: initialise_display_and_copper
description: Sets up the display: writes the colour zero register, display window and fetch registers, bitplane modulo and pointer values and the copper pointer, enables the DMA and interrupt registers, runs a helper-driven wait until a flag clears, clears a buffer, and ends in an endless loop.

name: copy_palette_to_two_tables
description: Counts a global value down or calls a helper otherwise, then copies a 32-word palette block into two fixed tables in parallel and sets the global to sixteen.

name: decode_joystick_port_state
description: Derives direction bits from joystick port movement data by exclusive-or of paired bits, adds further bits for the fire input and the other axis, and stores the combined state in a global byte.

name: swap_buffer_pointer_pair
description: Toggles a global flag and writes one of two buffer addresses into five pointer slots, alternating between the two addresses on each call.

name: set_buffer_pointer_slots
description: Writes one fixed buffer address into five pointer slots.

name: fill_pointer_list_with_stride
description: Fills four pointer slots in a list with a starting address that increases by forty bytes per slot.

name: reset_audio_channels_and_call
description: Clears per-channel volume and state words, sets the audio control register, computes a table pointer from an index byte, and calls a routine through a pointer.

name: dispatch_indexed_handler
description: Stores fixed values into fields of a state block, reads a byte at an index from a table to derive pointers, and calls a handler through a stored pointer.

name: dispatch_indexed_handler_b
description: Sets two fields of a state block to fixed values, reads a byte from the input pointer, derives a pointer from it, and calls a handler selected from a table by a following byte.

name: dispatch_indexed_handler_c
description: Sets two fields of a state block to fixed values, reads a byte from the input pointer, derives a pointer from it, and calls a handler selected from a table by a following byte.

name: reset_state_bytes_block
description: Clears nine state bytes, writes a word of eight into a state field, sets two more state bytes to 255, and returns.

name: clear_audio_state_fields
description: Sets a global value to fifteen, clears the four audio channel volume registers and one state byte, and returns.

name: store_byte_and_dispatch
description: Stores one byte from the input pointer into a state field, then calls a routine chosen from a table by the following byte.

name: store_byte_and_dispatch_b
description: Stores one byte from the input pointer into a different state field, then calls a routine chosen from a table by the following byte.

name: store_two_bytes_dispatch
description: Stores two bytes from the input pointer into state fields and a derived pointer, then calls a routine chosen from a table by the third byte.

name: store_two_bytes_dispatch_b
description: Stores two bytes from the input pointer into state fields and a derived pointer, then calls a routine chosen from a table by the third byte.

name: dispatch_byte_table_handler
description: Calls a routine chosen from a table by the byte at the input pointer.

name: store_pointer_and_dispatch
description: Stores two bytes and a pointer from the input into state fields, sets a flag byte, then calls a routine chosen from a table by the byte the pointer addresses.

name: store_bytes_and_dispatch
description: Stores three bytes and a longword from the input into state fields, then calls a routine chosen from a table by the fourth byte.

name: countdown_and_load_table_values
description: Decrements three countdown bytes; when one goes negative it calls a handler chosen from a table, otherwise it loads four table values into record fields and sets a flag bit.

name: countdown_and_load_table_copy
description: Same body as the preceding countdown routine.

name: scan_command_bytes_until_limit
description: Stores a fixed word, then reads bytes from a command list, skipping entries that match a stored value, until a byte falls below a limit; it then runs the countdown and table-load steps of the countdown routines.

name: resolve_table_entry_or_reset
description: Reads a table entry from a pointer: when the entry is negative it clears the state and returns; otherwise it stores a derived pointer and calls a handler selected from a table by the entry's value.

name: scan_command_list_with_init
description: Initialises several fields from input bytes and a word, then scans a command list as the preceding scan routine does until a byte falls below a limit, followed by the countdown and table-load steps.
